description: Fix GPX paths not reloading on leave/return: read persisted gpx_points back into the editor buffer via a PathSelectTrack UiAction + GetNodeProperties round-trip
wave_rationale: Smallest unit, unblocks in-app testing of the whole GPX reorient. Ultrapilot work unit W1.
notes: Reuses Track-1 hardening's NodePropertiesLoaded/NodeDeleted change-notification backbone. Root cause is the deliberate points.clear() in start_editing (documented no-read-back v1 limitation). No new message types.
